description: This file defines the Facebook class which extends the BaseFacebook class to manage Facebook SDK functionalities, including session handling with PHP sessions and shared cookies. It implements mechanisms for persistent data storage, shared session initialization, and cookie management for Facebook login sessions.

classes.name: Facebook
classes.description: A class extending BaseFacebook that manages Facebook SDK session handling with PHP sessions and shared cookies, including initialization, persistent data management, and cookie handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that starts a PHP session and initializes shared session if configured.

methods.name: initSharedSession
methods.description: Initializes or recreates a shared session using cookies and signed requests.

methods.name: setPersistentData
methods.description: Stores data persistently in PHP sessions for a given key.

methods.name: getPersistentData
methods.description: Retrieves data stored in PHP sessions for a given key, with a default fallback.

methods.name: clearPersistentData
methods.description: Removes persistent data for a specified key from PHP sessions.

methods.name: clearAllPersistentData
methods.description: Clears all persistent stored data and deletes shared session cookies if applicable.

methods.name: getSharedSessionCookieName
methods.description: Returns the cookie name used for shared sessions based on app ID.

methods.name: constructSessionVariableName
methods.description: Constructs session variable names based on app ID and shared session ID.
